# FHIR R6 conformance

<!-- Generated by :core:conformance:test. Do not edit by hand. -->

What this server does about the RESTful rules in the FHIR R6 specification, observed by driving
the real HTTP surface against a real database.

**18 of 18 applicable rules supported. 6 deliberately out of scope.**

A rule marked out of scope is one dbo has drawn a boundary around rather
than one it gets wrong; the CapabilityStatement declares the same boundary.
Search is tier 1 by design — see the REQ catalogue for what that covers.

## Instance interactions

| Rule | Specification | Level | Observed |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET [type]/[id]` reads the current version | http.html#read | ✅ supported | 200 with the resource |
| A read carries `ETag` and `Last-Modified` | http.html#read | ✅ supported | both present |
| `PUT` updates and advances the version | http.html#update | ✅ supported | version W/"1" -> W/"2" |
| `PUT` with a matching `If-Match` succeeds | http.html#concurrency | ✅ supported | 200 on the current version |
| `PUT` with a stale `If-Match` answers 412 | http.html#concurrency | ✅ supported | 412 Precondition Failed |
| `GET [type]/[id]/_history` returns a history Bundle | http.html#history | ✅ supported | 200, Bundle.type = history |
| Reading an unknown id answers 404 with an OperationOutcome | http.html#read | ✅ supported | 404 + OperationOutcome |

## Type interactions

| Rule | Specification | Level | Observed |
|---|---|---|---|
| `POST` creates and answers 201 with a `Location` | http.html#create | ✅ supported | 201, Location: http://127.0.0.1:54684/fhir/Patient/01a01ebb-0c60-716a-aff8-8e00d3daee84 |
| A create answers with an `ETag` carrying the version | http.html#versioning | ✅ supported | ETag W/"1" |
| `PATCH` on an instance | http.html#patch | ⚪ out of scope | Not implemented; update is whole-resource. The CapabilityStatement omits it. |

## System interactions

| Rule | Specification | Level | Observed |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET /metadata` returns a CapabilityStatement | http.html#capabilities | ✅ supported | 200, CapabilityStatement |
| The CapabilityStatement declares the FHIR version it serves | capabilitystatement.html | ✅ supported | fhirVersion present |
| Batch and transaction Bundles | http.html#transaction | ⚪ out of scope | Not implemented. Writes are single-resource, and the engine's guarantee is one transaction per write. |
| GraphQL | graphql.html | ⚪ out of scope | Not implemented. |

## Search

| Rule | Specification | Level | Observed |
|---|---|---|---|
| A search returns a searchset Bundle with a self link | search.html#return | ✅ supported | 200, searchset with self link |
| Token search by identifier finds the resource | search.html#token | ✅ supported | 200, matched on system\|value |
| `_summary=count` answers a count without entries | search.html#summary | ✅ supported | 200, total present |
| An unsupported search parameter is refused, not ignored | search.html#errors | ✅ supported | 400 — strict by default, because a silently dropped filter returns a wrong result set |
| `_filter`, `_has`, composite parameters, full-text | search.html#filter | ⚪ out of scope | Tier 2 and 3 by design — measured at zero production usage in the search inventory, and unclaimed in the CapabilityStatement. |
| `_revinclude` | search.html#revinclude | ⚪ out of scope | Tier 2. `_include` is supported. |

## Error signalling

| Rule | Specification | Level | Observed |
|---|---|---|---|
| A malformed body is refused with an OperationOutcome | http.html#mime-type | ✅ supported | 400 + OperationOutcome |

## Content and negotiation

| Rule | Specification | Level | Observed |
|---|---|---|---|
| Responses are served as `application/fhir+json` | http.html#mime-type | ✅ supported | application/fhir+json |
| What the server returns, the server accepts again | http.html#update | ✅ supported | 200 — the response form passes the write validation gate |
| XML representation | http.html#mime-type | ⚪ out of scope | JSON only, deliberately: one representation to validate and to sign. |

## What this report is not

It is a statement of level, not a certificate. It exercises the RESTful
interaction rules and the shapes of what comes back; it does not run an
external conformance service, and it does not validate every response
against the full StructureDefinition set. Where a response is round-tripped
through the server's own write-validation gate, the report says so.
